name: ui-button
description: Bootstrap button: solid, outline, subtle, text and link in every theme colour, styled, sizes, icon buttons, toggle, links, form submit/reset.

descriptions.--bs-btn-min-height: Minimum height (icon buttons are as wide as high).
descriptions.--bs-btn-color: Text colour of the base button (appearances set it from the theme colour).
descriptions.--bs-btn-white-space: Wrapping of the label (nowrap by default).
descriptions.--bs-btn-border-color: Border colour of the base button.
descriptions.--bs-btn-transition-property: Properties animated on hover and press.
descriptions.--bs-btn-border-mix-color: styled: colour mixed into the border.
descriptions.--bs-btn-border-mix-amount: styled: amount of that colour at rest.
descriptions.--bs-btn-border-hover-mix-amount: styled: amount of that colour on hover.
descriptions.--bs-btn-border-active-mix-amount: styled: amount of that colour while pressed.
descriptions.--bs-btn-active-shadow: styled: shadow while pressed or active.
